6660.title: Active voice capture is discarded by composer teardown
6660.rootCauseOneLine: Composer teardown disables transcription and clears buffered audio before a live recording can enter the recoverable recording store.
6660.proposedFix: Choose an explicit navigation policy, preserve captured audio before teardown, and reserve destructive discard for explicit cancellation. Persistent draft delivery and ephemeral question inputs need distinct ownership decisions.
6660.caveats: Verified twice at the real React hook boundary with the existing asynchronous MediaRecorder fake; not a physical macOS microphone or provider-service test. The full repeatable test and observed output are inline in the report, following the reports repository policy. No automatic fix: changing the explicitly tested teardown policy requires a product decision.
